name: BAMBA Eid Celebration Concert
notes: Multi-band BAMBA-organized Eid celebration concert featuring Warfaze, Maqsood O Dhaka, Renaissance, Nemesis and Mechanix, illustrative of BAMBA's role as an industry association coordinating large multi-act rock/metal showcases around festival calendar dates (Eid). Year (2 August) is drawn from a Dhaka Tribune report; the specific year of the report requires further verification and is currently treated as approximate. Additional lineup artists (Maqsood O Dhaka, Renaissance, Nemesis, Mechanix) are not yet catalogued in data/artists and should be added in a future pass.

sources.title: Warfaze, Maqsood O Dhaka, Renaissance, Nemesis and Mechanix rocked the concert — Dhaka Tribune
